text:
Maria Hernandez: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — leadership asked for clarifications on pipeline health, partner motions, and next-quarter GTM asks. Drop questions here and we’ll answer live for 15 mins.

Samir Patel: Quick one — how confident are we on the Q2 committed ARR in the forecast? some deals look soft. any specific segments we should focus on? :thinking_face:

Evan Cole: short answer: cautiously optimistic. Top 10 deals are ~60% of commit; we need tighter playbooks for mid-market renewals. Ops will share deal-level flags by EOD.

Tessa Nguyen: @Evan can RevOps push a CSV of deal tags + risk (red/amber/green)? reps need it in Salesforce to prioritize.

Maria Hernandez: Yes — Tessa and RevOps will publish a filtered report. Expect /shared/drive/gtm/q2_deal_flags.csv link.

Jia Chen: On partnerships — are we accelerating partner enablement (co-sell decks, joint pilots)? partners asked for clearer SLAs around lead routing.

Evan Cole: Partners are a priority. Short plan: 1) publish partner playbook v1 this week, 2) dedicated SDR-to-partner routing pilot next month, 3) formal revenue share guidance by end of quarter. Jia will lead playbook with Product and Sales. :rocket:

Nora Patel: Will the partner playbook include enablement templates (slide deck + demo scripts)? reps need plug-and-play content.

Jia Chen: Yes — templates + a 30-min enablement recording. Nora, can your team take the first enablement session for EMEA pilot?

Nora Patel: happy to run EMEA pilot the week of May 12.

Calvin Reed: For co-sell support: what level of CS involvement do we expect for initial pilots? we often get pulled in late.

Evan Cole: For pilots, require a CS PM assigned at kickoff (0.2 FTE/quarter). We’ll track success criteria in the playbook.

Oliver Brooks: from product side — any constraints on roadmap to support partner integrations? e.g., simpler API key onboarding or webhooks?

Maria Hernandez: Good call. Product to prioritize webhook reliability and a “partner onboarding” API in the next sprint. Oliver, can you estimate effort by EOW?

Oliver Brooks: I’ll post an estimate in the product channel by Friday. 1–2 sprints likely for an MVP.

Samir Patel: One more ask — can leadership share top 3 GTM KPIs we should optimize for this quarter (so AEs can align activities)?

Evan Cole: Top 3: 1) Net new ARR (bookings), 2) Win rate in SMB-mid market, 3) Partner-sourced pipeline contribution. We’ll add these to the weekly scoreboard.

Tessa Nguyen: I’ll add those KPIs to the Rep dashboard and create an automagic alert for when win rate drops >5% week-over-week.

Maria Hernandez: Action items recap: 1) RevOps: deal flags CSV (Tessa) by EOD, 2) Jia: partner playbook v1 this week, 3) Product: webhook/onboarding estimate (Oliver) by Friday, 4) Nora: EMEA enablement week of May 12, 5) CS: assign PMs to pilots. I’ll ping owners in the tracker. :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Thanks — appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:

allhands-bot: Recording + notes from today’s all-hands posted: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/2026-05-01-recording (permissions: company-wide).

Evan Cole: we’ll jump in if anything changes. keep questions coming here or DM Maria if you need privacy. :eyes:
